summary: Windows real-device verification remains blocked until a clean Windows 11 device or VM proves one-line install through first-screen arrival.
privacyRequirements: Evidence references must be redacted before they are attached to a GitHub issue or release PR.
Support bundles must not include tokens, cookies, credentials, browser session data, or file contents.
Failure evidence may include support bundle summaries, bootstrap logs, prod-smoke logs, screenshots, and command transcripts only after credential redaction.

deviceRuns.blocker: Clean Windows 11 device or VM evidence is missing.
requiredEvidence: Clean Windows 11 one-line installer command reaches the local first screen.
UAC elevation, Node/Git/Corepack/pnpm, WSL/Ubuntu, Codex CLI, Visual C++ runtime, desktop shortcut, rerun, and safe update paths match README and troubleshooting docs.
Failure path includes redacted support bundle and bootstrap/prod-smoke logs when any prerequisite blocks first-screen arrival.
unblockCriteria: Attach redacted Windows device or VM evidence to #259.
Split any discovered blocker into a separate fix issue/PR before changing this run to passed.
Run pnpm verify:windows-real-device -- --require-device-evidence and pnpm verify:release-readiness -- --require-ready with the final evidence contract.
